resources.string: Types what you dictate into whatever text box is focused, in any app. This is the only part of SideKey that can see the screen, and it looks only when a transcript is ready to insert. It is separate from the other SideKey service so you can use one without the other.
Lets a SideKey slot press Back, open the notification shade, take a screenshot or lock the screen. SideKey reads nothing from your screen.
